Databricks, MLflow, Delta, scheduled jobs, drift monitoring, retraining and unusually deep automated testing, plus agent governance which few MLOps candidates carry.
Multiple paid contracts delivering governed lakehouses and pipelines on AWS, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric with reconciliation, lineage and quarantine controls.
Statistical inference at scale, leakage-safe validation, forecasting and health, education and public-policy domain datasets.
dbt, semantic layers, dimensional modelling and KPI certification recur across both contract and independent work.
Data quality registers, validation assertions, reconciliation, quarantine, lineage and metric ownership appear across many engagements, including paid ones.
Strong stakeholder-facing analysis with Power BI, Excel and hypothesis testing, plus the only long-tenured named-employer experience in the profile.
Recommenders, valuation models, OCR fine-tuning and serving with monitoring and CI/CD, mostly on paid contracts.
Architecture ownership is evidenced on several engagements, but always as a delivering engineer rather than under an architect title.

hard_constraints.note: A posting matching any of these is a genuine reject. Keep this list short.

blockers.blocker: Role requires permanent relocation outside Victoria
blockers.reason: Based in Melbourne with no stated willingness to relocate.

blockers.blocker: Role requires a security clearance the candidate does not hold and the employer will not sponsor
blockers.reason: No clearance is evidenced in any source material.

blockers.blocker: Role requires a postgraduate qualification as a stated non-negotiable
blockers.reason: Highest qualification is a BSc plus an Advanced Diploma. See candidate-profile education records.

blockers.blocker: Role requires a specific professional registration or licence not held

years_in_title_rule.hard_reject_only_when: The posting states the exact titled-years requirement as non-negotiable or regulatory and adjacent equivalent experience cannot satisfy it.
years_in_title_rule.note: A stated years requirement in a particular job title is not a HARD BLOCKER merely because the candidate has not held that exact title.

soft_preferences.policy_state: SOFT NEGATIVE or SOFT POSITIVE, never a rejection on its own

unacceptable: Roles requiring permanent relocation outside Victoria
Roles requiring full-time onsite attendance outside greater Melbourne
locations.max_commute_notes: Based in Craigieburn. Melbourne CBD and inner-suburb hybrid roles are workable; daily attendance far from the northern corridor is a soft negative, not a blocker.

seniority.note: People-management roles are outside the evidence base: the source material shows workstream and delivery ownership, not line management. Head-of and manager titles should be flagged for review, not auto-rejected.

employment_basis.note: Permanent roles are strategically preferred because the current record is contractor-heavy and light on named, referenceable employers.

items.preference: Named, referenceable employer rather than another anonymous engagement
Role concentrated in data quality, governance, MLOps, analytics engineering or applied AI rather than scattered across role families
Organisation in health, education, government, energy or financial services where the existing domain evidence applies
Roles requiring R as the primary language
Roles requiring deep Kubernetes, TensorFlow or Azure Data Factory experience
Pure dashboard-maintenance roles with no analytical or decision component
Roles materially more junior than the evidence supports

compensation_policy.note: No compensation floor has been confirmed by the candidate. Do not silently copy a runtime figure in here.
compensation_policy.routing_rule: Do not reject a posting on salary alone. Unstated pay, or pay materially below the observed range, routes to HUMAN_REVIEW.

never_auto_reject_on: compensation uncertainty or pay below observed_target_range alone
an EVIDENCE GAP in a not_currently_evidenced item alone

route_to.HARD_REJECT: Genuine hard constraint match, including regulatory exact-title years that cannot be satisfied.
route_to.LOW_PRIORITY_ARCHIVE: No hard blocker, but the title/family is not a plausible capability match. Do not spend deep-review budget.
route_to.DEEP_REVIEW: Plausible role-family relevance and no hard blocker. Retrieve a relevant evidence subset, then ask Jev for typed judgments.
route_to.HUMAN_REVIEW: Ambiguity: years-in-title, compensation uncertainty, missing critical fields, or a must-have evidence gap.

still_review_even_if_below_heuristic_whe: the candidate has strong adjacent evidence
the role has unusually high strategic value
the missing requirement can reasonably be learned
the requirement is a preference rather than a must-have

boost_signals.when: posting concerns trust, safety, governance, evaluation or regulated decisions
posting asks for hypothesis testing or analytical independence
posting mentions agent permissions, guardrails or auditability

ranking_policy.note: Boost signals inform ordering among postings that already passed triage. They never override a HARD BLOCKER and never manufacture a pass on their own.

differentiator_weights.when: posting concerns trust, safety, governance, evaluation or regulated decisions
differentiator_weights.based_on: Repeated negative findings and declined automation (P40, P54, P55, P60, P62).

differentiator_weights.when: posting asks for hypothesis testing or analytical independence
differentiator_weights.based_on: Disproved stakeholder assumptions on real data (P29, P51).

differentiator_weights.when: posting mentions agent permissions, guardrails or auditability
differentiator_weights.based_on: Agent governance depth across P38, P45, P48, P49, P64.

cv_format: One page, plain text output when drafted in conversation
A single Professional Experience section with no separate Projects heading
At most three to four detailed experience entries; remaining work compressed into one short 'further delivery' line
Strong profile, then a bulleted list of six to eight key skills, then achievements, so roughly 80 percent of the posting's requirements are visible by halfway down page one
labelling_rules: Paid contracts labelled '(Contract)' with sector and NDA notation where applicable
Independent builds labelled '(Independent Delivery)' with a GitHub link
Team projects labelled with team size and the candidate's specific role
Never label an independent build as a client engagement under any wording
Every entry carries a period; unexplained gaps of a year or more are addressed explicitly

title_tailoring_rule.rule: Never upgrade or retitle a historical role simply because a posting uses different title wording.

strategy_items: Extract the five or six key requirements from each posting and build the application around them
Mirror the posting's exact terminology wherever it is accurate, without keyword stuffing
Replace duty language with action verbs plus figures showing scale and result
Control the explanation of any gap or red flag rather than leaving the employer to invent one
Concentrate applications in a small number of role families rather than spreading across six
Australian universities and public sector employers frequently require a separate Key Selection Criteria response; check for one and treat it as the primary scored document

career_goals.primary_objective: Secure a permanent or fixed-term role in an Australian organisation where data or AI work is owned inside a team rather than delivered from outside it.
motivations: Work where the data leads to a decision rather than stopping at a report
Build a verifiable, referenceable employment record inside a named organisation
Continue working on problems where evaluation and trustworthiness matter

requirement_match_guidance.heuristic: Roughly 80 percent of a posting's stated requirements is a useful focusing guideline, not an automatic cutoff. 20 focused applications beat 200 scattered ones.
still_review_even_if_below_heuristic_whe: the candidate has strong adjacent evidence
the role has unusually high strategic value
the missing requirement can reasonably be learned
the requirement is a preference rather than a must-have

claim_use_policy.forbidden_claims_rule: Items in candidate-profile.json claim_policy.forbidden_claims must never be used in any application material, in any wording.
claim_use_policy.qualified_claims_rule: Items in candidate-profile.json claim_policy.qualified_claims may be used only with their required_qualification carried in the same sentence.
claim_use_policy.not_currently_evidenced_rule: Items in candidate-profile.json claim_policy.not_currently_evidenced are an EVIDENCE GAP, not a forbidden claim. Do not claim them today; if a posting requires one as a must-have, route to HUMAN_REVIEW rather than silently rejecting or silently claiming it.
avoid: Never fabricate achievements, clients, teams or metrics, including with AI assistance
Never state a figure below a posting's stated numeric threshold in a way that reads as falling short when the evidence supports more
Never present Project 02 (Hospital Capacity) metrics in any application material

human_review_rules.trigger: Application to a reference-sensitive sector (university, government, large enterprise) where EXP-01 contract engagements are the primary evidence
human_review_rules.reason: Client identities are unnamed or under NDA for nearly all engagements since 2020; no named referee is evidenced for any of them. This is the single largest verifiability weakness in the profile and a plausible cause of rejection in reference-sensitive sectors.

human_review_rules.trigger: Drafting a CV or application where EXP-02 (Australian Intercultural Society) is a relevant fit
human_review_rules.reason: EXP-02 is the strongest verifiability asset in the record: a named, long-tenured, referenceable employer with board-level exposure. It is under-weighted in generic CV drafts relative to its value for university, government and not-for-profit applications.
human_review_rules.action_hint: Foreground EXP-02 for university, government and not-for-profit applications.

human_review_rules.trigger: Any question about activity between December 2020 and June 2023
human_review_rules.reason: No source document covers this period.
